name: RC-B10-0071/2026 – After § 12 – Am 18
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the brutal repression against protesters in Iran
part_text: 12b. Calls, in line with the recommendations of the UN Special Rapporteur on unilateral coercive measures, for the immediate lifting of those European sanctions on Iran that have a negative influence on the human rights and living conditions of the Iranian people; calls for the reactivation of EU mechanisms that allow the circumvention of US sanctions;
